```bash
kubectl get deployment app -n default -o yaml > /tmp/app-deploy.yaml && \
sed -i 's|path: /readyz|path: /|g' /tmp/app-deploy.yaml && \
kubectl apply -f /tmp/app-deploy.yaml -n default
```

- **Pod readiness**: All 3 pods now show `1/1` Ready status (previously `0/1`)

- **Endpoints**: All 3 pod IPs are now listed in ready `addresses` (no longer in `notReadyAddresses`)
- **Service connectivity**: Requests through the `app` service succeed, returning the nginx welcome page

**Change details**: Only the readiness probe path was modified (`/readyz` → `/`). All other configuration including image, ports, thresholds, and replica count remained unchanged.
